_why_here: Location chosen as tools/review/actors.json for three reasons. (1) Its only
consumers are tools/review/panel.py and the review workflows, and a registry
that lives beside its consumer cannot drift into being nobody's file.
(2) It must NOT live under dot-claude/, because that tree is committed payload
for ~/.claude and is not live until deployed; a GitHub Actions runner checks
out this repo and would read a registry that the live machine had already
moved past. (3) It must NOT live under state/, whose files are append-only
ledgers; this is mutable configuration, and editing a ledger row in place is
_decorrelation_contract: ADR-0004 and the persona-review-economy spec require that personas whose
findings are compared in the agreement gate be enacted by DIFFERENT model
families. The load-bearing subtlety this registry exists to make impossible to
get wrong: HOST IS NOT FAMILY. nvidia-nim and openrouter are both multi-vendor
resellers, and both can serve deepseek, qwen, and llama. Picking 'nvidia' and
'openrouter' as two independent reviewers can silently produce the same weights
twice, which is a correlated pair wearing two names, and the gate would report
agreement that carries no information. So every actor declares model_family
separately from host, and the allocator must decorrelate on model_family.

_reachability_legend.unreachable: a call was attempted on the stated date and failed

notes: THE FREE CLAIM IS FALSE, and it was checked rather than taken on trust.
OpenRouter's own catalogue prices z-ai/glm-4.7-flash at $0.06/M input and
$0.40/M output, there is no `:free` variant of it among the 14 models
currently carrying that suffix, and a measured call returned a usage block
billing cost 0.000434712 USD. It is very cheap; it is not free. The other
circulating figure, $0.60/$1.92, is also wrong by an order of magnitude.
The cost matters structurally, not morally: tools/openrouter/client.py is
built around ZERO-PRICED models, its fallback pool is `free_models()`, and
its DailyQuota counts REQUESTS rather than dollars. Naming a priced model
leaves the free tier while every guard in the client still reads green.
Reasoning model. It spent 564 to 904 completion tokens thinking before
emitting an answer, so it needs a completion budget near 4000; at panel's
old 1200 it returned unparseable reasoning that the panel scored as zero
findings, which is exactly what a clean review looks like.
First finding produced 2026-07-31: two high-severity injection findings
with correct line citations, 0 dropped, through the wired panel path.
Family zhipu-glm is genuinely distinct from anthropic-claude, google-gemini
and openai-gpt, which is the entire reason to pay anything for it.

notes: The key authenticates against the INTERNATIONAL endpoint
dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com (HTTP 200 on /compatible-mode/v1/models) and is
rejected by the mainland endpoint dashscope.aliyuncs.com with HTTP 401
invalid_api_key. A probe that tried only the mainland host would have
reported this key dead. Region is part of reachability.
No client exists under tools/ for this actor; it is reachable but unwired.
Caution recorded during probing: OpenRouter's /api/v1/models returns HTTP
200 to ANY bearer token because that route is unauthenticated, so a 200
there is not evidence a key is valid. Probe an endpoint that actually
checks auth before recording a key as good.
